members.description: Three steps to add a member and continue directly to subscription setup.
members.step1Body: Name, mobile number, and branch are required; duplicates are checked before saving.
members.step2Body: On save, the server creates the branch prefix plus a 6-digit sequence; the preview does not reserve a code.
members.step3Body: “Save & add subscription” saves once, then opens subscription setup with the member preselected.

subscriptions.description: Link the member to a plan and record collection in one flow.
subscriptions.step1Body: A member arriving from the add-member screen is preselected; you can also search by code or name.
subscriptions.step2Body: Selecting a package fills its value, duration, and end date from the plan settings.
subscriptions.step3Body: Enter the paid amount and payment method; the outstanding balance appears before confirmation.
